what_happened: Dispatch's Item 2 option (ii) claimed the aux_pending chain-state obligation 'is recorded in the multi-task state file, which the planner already reads'; measured that orchestrate-triage-classify.sh (the component that makes the blocked-discharge decision) reads only specs/state.json and a candidate's own .orchestrator-handoff.json per its own documented header, never the per-invocation multi-task state file where aux_pending lives (that file is loaded only inside orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh via mt_get/mt_set). Recommended placing the Item 2 override as post-triage-group post-processing inside orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh instead of inside the classifier script; outcome of option (ii) preserved, ground corrected.

Neither the dispatch nor the research report noticed that test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh Group 10 Case A already asserts the OPPOSITE of the chosen Item 1 remedy ('aux: blocker-research clears aux_pending...', reading .aux_pending[$t] // "CLEARED" and passing only when absent). Both framed the test work as purely additive. Confirmed by grepping aux_pending across the 6274-line suite during planning. Plan Phase 1 now carries an explicit task to invert that assertion in place and a Scope Hypothesis bounding the sweep, so an implementer does not read the resulting red as a broken fix and revert a correct change.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification under-verification check caught a real authoring gap at plan-acceptance time: Phase 3's justification named only the three suites suite_selection_select returns for the script path, omitting the two further suites the phase's TEST file path also maps to. Corrected to the exact five-suite union before the plan was accepted, at zero implementation cost.

Phases 1, 2, 4 and 5 all share orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh and test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh in genuinely disjoint code regions. Reconstructed clean, per-phase-isolated git commits after the fact by diffing HEAD against the final cumulative file, confirming the hunks were disjoint per phase, and rebuilding each phase's incremental file content via exact string replacement before committing in sequence -- recovering the one-commit-per-phase contract despite having implemented out of commit order.

test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's sandboxed script-copy set (require_file list and cp loop) did not include issue-record.sh, even though an existing dormant call site (MAX_INFRA_FAILURES) already invoked it; the gap only surfaced when the new cap-audibility case in Phase 2 actually exercised that code path.

Task 547's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
